scope: One-hop explicitly linked GitHub source files, commit patches, PR metadata/patches, and linked issue discussions. Branch links reflect retrieval-time content unless resolved to a commit. No recursive expansion or external attachments.

links.recovery_method: Exact repository/path Git history; explicit commit or its recorded direct parent
links.reason: Historical file recovered at a verified path-history commit. Original branch target and case-time version are unknown; cited line semantics may differ. Do not infer deployment or resolution.
